name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #fff at 100% opacity. This keeps the ring visible on all backgrounds while ensuring the focus indicator remains clear for keyboard users. The trade-off is slightly less crisp edges on high-DPI screens, but the improved visibility and consistency across devices outweighs this minor flaw.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring still risks failing WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast on light backgrounds—#005fcc measures 3.1:1 against white. Switch to a 3px ring with a 1px inner #fff at 80% opacity; it meets contrast and stays sharp on high-DPI screens. Test with Playwright MCP’s accessibility scan to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:
We should adopt the 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner #fff at 80% opacity. This decision ensures the focus indicator meets the 3:1 contrast requirement on light backgrounds, making it more accessible for users with visual impairments. The trade-off is a slightly less vibrant focus ring due to the reduced opacity, but this is outweighed by the improved accessibility and sharper edges on high-DPI screens. By using Playwright MCP's accessibility scan, we can confirm that this solution meets the necessary standards for contrast and clarity.

name: Reader
text: The 3px ring with 80% inner white risks blurring into adjacent interactive elements on high-contrast or dark themes—its soft edges reduce clarity. Instead, use a 2px solid #005fcc ring with a 2px inner #fff at 100% opacity, then test with Playwright MCP’s contrast scan; if it fails, bump the outer ring to #004499 (4.5:1 on white).
